## Summary

What problem does this solve, and what changed?

## Trust / compatibility

- Does inspection remain read-only and build trust explicit?
- Does this change native platform, output, profile or process-lifecycle behavior?

## Actual verification

List exact commands, host/interpreter, outcomes and native artifact launch evidence. Distinguish passed, failed, skipped and never run.

- [ ] Lint and strict core types
- [ ] Relevant unit/GUI failure, cancel, repeat and shutdown coverage
- [ ] Reviewed native build/launch checks where relevant
- [ ] sdist/wheel checks and strict dependency audit
- [ ] Docs/changelog updated without unverified compatibility/release claims

## Remaining limitations
